reason: Constructor validation makes the supplied list available immediately, but it also raises on invalid vocabularies during construction and consumes one-shot vocabularies before fit, neither of which the five passing tests exercise.
The empty-list shortcut avoids the warning, but calling len on a scalar number raises TypeError, consistent with the recorded failure of test_convert_one_number.
Clearing the exception for every test carrying an xfail marker discards genuine failures even when the marker condition is false, and the recorded boolean xfail test fails.
The example keeps its short 0.009125 spelling, but formatting 1E-10 as 1.0E-10 can truncate a previously fitting comment, a case the recorded tests do not cover.
